title: A Newport Christmas
description: A socialite from 1905 is swept to 2025, where she falls in love and must choose between a new future and preserving the life she left behind.

title: The Christmas Bookshop
description: The story of a structured Christmas expert and a laid-back bookstore owner who clash, but their rivalry blossoms into a heart-warming romance.

title: She's Making A List
description: A naughty-or-nice inspector falls for a widowed father while evaluating his daughter, forcing her to choose between duty and love.

title: The More The Merrier
description: Alice, an ER doctor, volunteers to work Christmas Eve. During a snowy Christmas, Alice and Brian, a top-rated cardiologist, help deliver three baby booms, sparking a lasting bond.

title: Holiday Touchdown: A Chief's...
description: Chiefs superfan Alana tries to win the Fan of the Year Award as a Christmas gift for her family, falling in love with someone from the Chiefs' front office along the way.

title: All I Need For Christmas
description: Looking for inspiration, singer songwriter Maggie travels home and finds a spark with app developer Archer, who's trying to repair his relationship with his sister.

title: Santa Tell Me
description: When Olivia finds a letter from Santa promising she'll meet the love of her life by Christmas Eve - and that his name will be Nick - she's stunned by three potential suitors.

title: Christmas With A Kiss
description: Romance ignites after a woman returns home to help with her family's Christmas Carnival.

title: The Secret Gifts Of Christmas
description: Can personal shopper Bonnie help widowed client Patrick reconnect with his daughter and find everything on his wish list.

title: Polar Opposites
description: Emma needs to get to Antarctica to reach her dad. She gets to South America but can't get on a boat for the last leg. She sneaks onto a cruise ship and meets engineer Andy.

title: The Snow Must Go On
description: A teacher takes his students to a breathtaking glacier. However, soon the students realise the impact of global warming and strive to protect the glacier from disappearing.

title: Believe In Christmas
description: When Beatrice reluctantly joins her best friend on a trip to the enchanting Christmasland, she remains sceptical. But festive traditions and a friendly stranger warms her heart.

title: Tidings For The Season
description: A serious TV newscaster's life changes when he meets his young superfan and the boy's hardworking single mum, but a career opportunity forces him to choose between ambition and love.

title: Christmas Under The Lights
description: Emily reluctantly returns home to her family's rescue ranch to organise the Christmas Carnival to honour her mother, meeting a handsome artist along the way.

title: Our Holiday Playbook
description: Lexi strikes a deal with a former football star to save her family's Christmas football tradition, but their fake romance soon turns into something real.

title: Christmas At The Catnip Cafe
description: Olivia, discovers her late great aunt's cat café, which she believes will be a Christmas miracle. Helping plan fundraising events, gaining appreciation for the feline inhabitants.

title: A Carol For Two
description: When talented singer Violette takes a job as a waitress in New York, things get complicated when her duet partner sets her up with a friend but starts developing feelings himself.

title: A Grand Ole Opry Christmas
description: Gentry, who gave up music after her father's death, must confront her past when the Grand Ole Opry invites her to honour her late country star dad at their Christmas celebration.

title: A Christmas Less Travelled
description: An old audio cassette of her dad's voice sends a woman on a journey to retrace her family's most memorable moments at Christmastime.

title: Mystery On Mistletoe Lane
description: Heidi discovers a Christmas mystery in her historic home. Local handyman and historian David helps along the way, finding his own surprising connection.
